title: How to clean a microwave with lemon

pieces.say: Stop scrubbing your microwave. Steam does the work.
pieces.text: Stop scrubbing your microwave. Steam does the work.
pieces.label: STOP DOING THIS

pieces.say: Here's the hidden trick. One lemon and a bowl of water.
Put half a sliced lemon in a bowl of water.
Heat it on high for three to five minutes.
Keep the door shut for five more.
Then wipe the splatter right off.
The bowl gets very hot, so use oven gloves.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
